headline: Oil gets cheaper globally, but experts point to one problem
summary: Oil prices fell as the market focused more on rising supply than on escalation of the conflict, though attacks on ships in the Strait of Hormuz continue. Analysts warn global stocks remain low.
why: Brent crude is the main global oil benchmark, and the Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of seaborne oil, so supply disruptions there move prices.
why_moved: Rising supply outweighed the market's concern over attacks on ships in the Strait of Hormuz.
original_headline: Ropa tanieje na świecie, ale eksperci wskazują na jeden problem
